summary.headline: Stars, Terms, Lots, and Earthquakes
summary.text: Catalog entries 299–311 for an Angelican codex, covering conjunctions of the highest stars, solar and lunar eclipses, winds, fixed-star positions and Persian names, Egyptian and Dorothean terms, lots, earthquakes, and Theophilus’s astrological inceptions and annual techniques. Cross-references cite Persian sources, Hermes Trismegistus, John Laurentius Lydus, Ptolemy, Dorotheus, and several Venetian and Vatican manuscripts.
